story.iWant: to see real analytics for my landing page
story.soThat: I can understand how visitors engage with my page and optimize it accordingly

tasks.task: Database Schema - Add pageViews and linkClicks tables to schema.ts, run migration
Backend Analytics Routes - Create server/routes/analytics.ts with 4 endpoints (track pageview, end session, track click, get stats)
Client-Side Tracking Library - Create client/src/lib/analytics.ts with trackPageView, trackPageEnd, trackLinkClick functions
Integrate Tracking in ArtistPage - Call trackPageView on mount, trackPageEnd on unload, trackLinkClick on link clicks
Update Landing Page Stats Display - Replace hardcoded landingPageStats with real data from analytics API
Testing - Verify tracking and aggregation work correctly

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Track page view on every ArtistPage load (with session/visitor identification)
Track link clicks when visitors click links on landing pages
Calculate unique visitors using session fingerprinting (IP + User-Agent hash)
Calculate average time on page using session start/end timestamps
Calculate click rate as (total clicks / total views) * 100
API endpoint returns aggregated stats for Dashboard display
Dashboard stats card displays real data instead of hardcoded values

package.name: drizzle-orm
package.reason: Database ORM for schema and queries

package.name: crypto
package.reason: Built-in Node.js module for visitor hash generation

constraints.constraint: No PII storage - use hashed visitor identifiers only (SHA-256 of IP + User-Agent)
Public tracking endpoints must not require authentication
Stats retrieval endpoint must require authentication and verify ownership
Use navigator.sendBeacon for page end tracking (non-blocking)
Follow existing drizzle-orm patterns for table definitions
Use existing apiRequest helper for authenticated endpoints

interface.name: POST /api/analytics/pageview
interface.signature: Request: { landingPageId: string, sessionId: string, referrer?: string } Response: { pageViewId: string }

interface.name: POST /api/analytics/pageview/:id/end
interface.signature: Request: { endedAt: string } Response: { success: boolean }

interface.name: POST /api/analytics/click
interface.signature: Request: { linkId: string, landingPageId: string, pageViewId?: string, sessionId: string } Response: { success: boolean }

interface.name: GET /api/analytics/landing-page/:id
interface.signature: Response: { totalViews: number, uniqueVisitors: number, avgTimeOnPage: number, clickRate: number, linkStats: Array }

interface.name: trackLinkClick
interface.signature: (linkId: string, landingPageId: string, pageViewId?: string) => Promise<void>

tests.standards: Use Vitest for unit/integration tests. Tests are co-located in __tests__ directories. Mock external dependencies. Test both success and error paths.

ideas.idea: Test pageViews and linkClicks table creation and foreign key constraints
Test pageview tracking endpoint creates record with correct visitor hash
Test click tracking endpoint creates record linked to correct link and page
Test unique visitor calculation returns distinct visitor_hash count
Test avg time calculation with started_at and ended_at timestamps
Test stats endpoint returns correct aggregated data
Test Dashboard renders real stats from API
